# Command reference

Every `greenfield` command, its options and examples. Run `greenfield <command> --help` for the same text in your terminal.

## Global options

These work before or after the command name, for example `greenfield --json status` or `greenfield status --json`.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--project DIR` | project folder (default: current folder) |
| `--json` | print JSON (default when stdout is not a terminal) |
| `-q, --quiet` | no progress or hint messages on stderr |
| `--no-color` | no colour (also off with NO_COLOR or TERM=dumb) |
| `--version` | print the version and exit |

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 a negative result you asked about (for example a broken ledger), 2 bad input or usage, 3 environment problem, 130 interrupted.

## Commands

- [`greenfield install`](#greenfield-install): install the skill and research roles into Claude Code and/or Codex
- [`greenfield uninstall`](#greenfield-uninstall): remove what install placed (edited files, research and other hooks are kept)
- [`greenfield hooks`](#greenfield-hooks): add or remove the opt-in Mission Control hooks
- [`greenfield start`](#greenfield-start): start a research run for an idea (refuses while another run is active)
- [`greenfield link`](#greenfield-link): point a run at its research folder
- [`greenfield status`](#greenfield-status): show a run: activity, tasks and the decision if scored
- [`greenfield task`](#greenfield-task): plan, claim and finish the research tasks of a run
- [`greenfield dashboard`](#greenfield-dashboard): serve Mission Control on this machine (Ctrl-C stops it)
- [`greenfield demo`](#greenfield-demo): create a labelled sample run to try the dashboard
- [`greenfield event`](#greenfield-event): record run events
- [`greenfield sources`](#greenfield-sources): check the sources cited in an evaluation
- [`greenfield ledger`](#greenfield-ledger): record and verify the hash-chained experiment ledger
- [`greenfield score`](#greenfield-score): validate and score an evaluation (text on a terminal, JSON when piped)
- [`greenfield portfolio`](#greenfield-portfolio): rank several scored ideas against each other
- [`greenfield doctor`](#greenfield-doctor): check your setup and print the command that fixes each problem
- [`greenfield report`](#greenfield-report): write the verdict callout and scorecard at the top of DECISION.md from decision.json
- [`greenfield profiles`](#greenfield-profiles): list the business-model profiles; show or compare them
- [`greenfield completion`](#greenfield-completion): print a shell completion script

## greenfield install

Install the skill and research roles into Claude Code and/or Codex.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--platform PLATFORM` | which agent host (default: both) (one of: claude, codex, both) |
| `--scope SCOPE` | install into --project or your home folder (one of: project, user) |
| `--no-agents` | install the skill only, not the nine research roles |
| `--force` | replace files this tool installed before |
| `--gitignore` | add private research folders to .gitignore without asking |
| `--no-gitignore` | never offer to edit .gitignore |
| `--overwrite-modified` | with --force, also replace role files you edited |
| `--dry-run` | show what would change and write nothing |

```text
greenfield install --platform both
greenfield install --scope user --platform claude --force
```

## greenfield uninstall

Remove what install placed (edited files, research and other hooks are kept).

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--platform PLATFORM` | which agent host (default: both) (one of: claude, codex, both) |
| `--scope SCOPE` | uninstall from --project, your home folder, or both (one of: project, user, all) |
| `--dry-run` | show what would be removed and remove nothing |
| `--yes` | do not ask for confirmation |
| `--keep-hooks` | leave Mission Control hooks in place |
| `--purge-telemetry` | also delete .greenfield-observe/ |

```text
greenfield uninstall --dry-run
greenfield uninstall --scope user --yes
```

## greenfield hooks

Add or remove the opt-in Mission Control hooks.

```text
greenfield hooks install --platform claude
greenfield hooks remove
```

## greenfield hooks install

Add the Mission Control hooks and the self-attestation guard.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--platform PLATFORM` | which agent host (default: both) (one of: claude, codex, both) |
| `--guard-only` | install only the self-attestation guard, not the Mission Control hooks |

```text
greenfield hooks install
greenfield hooks install --platform codex --project ~/code/app
```

## greenfield hooks remove

Remove this tool's hooks, keep all others.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--platform PLATFORM` | which agent host (default: both) (one of: claude, codex, both) |

```text
greenfield hooks remove
greenfield hooks remove --platform codex --project ~/code/app
```

## greenfield start

Start a research run for an idea (refuses while another run is active).

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--idea IDEA` | the business idea, in one line |
| `--provider PROVIDER` | agent host doing the research (one of: claude, codex, both) |
| `--new` | replace the active run if it is still running |
| `--research-dir DIR` | research folder this run produces, inside the project |
| `--slug SLUG` | folder name under research/greenfield/ (default: made from the idea) |
| `--model MODEL` | business-model profile (default: general) (one of: bootstrapped_saas, general, marketplace, regulated, services, venture_startup) |
| `--customer CUSTOMER` | initial customer, if known |
| `--geography GEOGRAPHY` | where the customer is, if known |
| `--depth DEPTH` | research depth (default: standard) (one of: quick, standard, deep) |
| `--as-of YYYY-MM-DD` | evaluation date (default: today, local time) |
| `--no-plan` | do not create the nine-task plan |

```text
greenfield start --idea 'AI bookkeeping for dentists'
greenfield start --idea 'Laundry routing' --provider claude --new
```

## greenfield link

Point a run at its research folder.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--run ID` | run id (default: the active run) |
| `--research-dir DIR` | research folder, inside the project |

```text
greenfield link --research-dir research/greenfield/my-idea
greenfield link --run 20261103T120000Z-ab12cd --research-dir research/x
```

## greenfield dashboard

Serve Mission Control on this machine (Ctrl-C stops it).

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--port PORT` | port on 127.0.0.1 (default 8765; 0 picks a free one) |
| `--allow-host NAME` | extra Host name to accept (port forwarding, tunnels) |
| `--open` | open the dashboard in your browser |

```text
greenfield dashboard --open
greenfield dashboard --port 8766
```

## greenfield demo

Create a labelled sample run to try the dashboard.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--new` | create it even while a real run is active (it will not replace it) |
| `--replay` | write the sample events in real time (about 100 seconds) so the dashboard moves |

```text
greenfield demo
greenfield demo --new && greenfield dashboard --open
greenfield demo --replay
```

## greenfield event

Record run events.

```text
greenfield event emit --event note --message 'Scoring next'
greenfield event emit --event source_seen --url https://www.census.gov/
```

## greenfield event emit

Record one event on a run.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--run ID` | run id (default: the active run) |
| `--event EVENT` | event type (one of: agent_completed, agent_failed, agent_started, artifact_created, note, run_completed, run_failed, run_resumed, run_started, source_seen, task_completed, task_failed, task_planned, task_started, token_usage, tool_completed, tool_failed, tool_started, warning) |
| `--agent AGENT` | who did it (default orchestrator) |
| `--message MESSAGE` | short summary (no secrets, no prompts) |
| `--tool TOOL` | tool name, for tool events |
| `--url URL` | public source URL, for source_seen |
| `--provider PROVIDER` | label for where the event came from |

```text
greenfield event emit --event note --message 'Scoring next'
greenfield event emit --event agent_started --agent gf-market
```

## greenfield sources

Check the sources cited in an evaluation.

```text
greenfield sources check evaluation.json --output source-verification.json
greenfield sources check evaluation.json --output out.json --allow-network
```

## greenfield sources check

Check citations offline (or fetch public pages with --allow-network).

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `evaluation` | evaluation.json (default: the active run's) |
| `--run ID` | run id (default: the active run) |
| `--output OUTPUT` | where to write the full report (default: source-verification.json beside the run's evaluation) |
| `--allow-network` | fetch PUBLIC pages; off by default |
| `--stale-days STALE_DAYS` | sources older than this are flagged (default 730) |

```text
greenfield sources check evaluation.json --output source-verification.json
greenfield sources check evaluation.json --output out.json --allow-network
```

## greenfield ledger

Record and verify the hash-chained experiment ledger.

```text
greenfield ledger verify --ledger experiment-ledger.jsonl
greenfield ledger summary --ledger experiment-ledger.jsonl
```

## greenfield ledger record

Append one event (receipts need a person at a terminal).

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--ledger LEDGER` | the .jsonl ledger file (default: the active run's) |
| `--run ID` | run id (default: the active run) |
| `--kind KIND` | event kind (one of: customer_action, customer_interview, decision_revision, experiment_result, failure, feasibility_proof, hypothesis, note, paid_test, repeat_purchase, signed_commitment, source_review) |
| `--project-name PROJECT_NAME` | the idea or project this event belongs to |
| `--hypothesis HYPOTHESIS` | the hypothesis tested |
| `--outcome OUTCOME` | what happened |
| `--artifact ARTIFACT` | evidence file inside the ledger's folder |
| `--attester ATTESTER` | the person confirming a receipt |
| `--observed-at DATE` | when it was observed (default today) |
| `--notes NOTES` | free-text notes |
| `--pillar PILLAR` | pillar this evidence supports (repeatable) |
| `--claim-id CLAIM_ID` | claim id, for source reviews |
| `--experiment-id EXPERIMENT_ID` | experiment id |

```text
greenfield ledger record --ledger experiment-ledger.jsonl --kind hypothesis --project-name 'Laundry routing' --hypothesis 'Owners pay for routing'
greenfield ledger record --ledger experiment-ledger.jsonl --kind note --project-name X --hypothesis H --notes 'call booked'
```

## greenfield ledger verify

Check the hash chain (exit 1 if broken).

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--ledger LEDGER` | the .jsonl ledger file (default: the active run's) |

```text

greenfield --json ledger verify --ledger research/greenfield/x/experiment-ledger.jsonl
```

## greenfield score

Validate and score an evaluation (text on a terminal, JSON when piped).

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `evaluation` | evaluation.json (default: the active run's) |
| `--run ID` | run id (default: the active run) |
| `--output OUTPUT` | also write the decision JSON here (default with no path: decision.json beside the run's evaluation) |
| `--all-warnings` | text mode: list every warning instead of the top 5 groups |

```text
greenfield score research/greenfield/my-idea/evaluation.json
greenfield --json score evaluation.json --output decision.json
```

## greenfield portfolio

Rank several scored ideas against each other.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `manifest` | portfolio manifest JSON |
| `--output OUTPUT` | where to write the ranking JSON |
| `--markdown MARKDOWN` | also write a Markdown table here |

```text
greenfield portfolio portfolio.json --output ranking.json
greenfield portfolio portfolio.json --output ranking.json --markdown ranking.md
```

## greenfield doctor

Check your setup and print the command that fixes each problem.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--fix` | repair folder permissions and .gitignore lines (nothing else is changed) |
| `--network` | also test the dashboard port and one HTTPS host (the only mode that opens sockets) |

```text
greenfield doctor
greenfield doctor --fix
greenfield --json doctor --network
```

## greenfield report

Write the verdict callout and scorecard at the top of DECISION.md from decision.json.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `folder` | research folder with evaluation.json and decision.json (default: the active run's) |
| `--run ID` | run id (default: the active run) |
| `--ascii` | use # and . instead of block characters |

```text
greenfield report
greenfield report research/greenfield/my-idea --ascii
```

| Option | What it does |
